edges.reason: BreederToken constructor assigns owner from tx.origin, enabling owner takeover through a phishing intermediate call.
owner state variable is written with tx.origin.
allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] = uint(-1) gives the deployer origin an unlimited spender approval.
uniPair is computed inside the constructor through pairForPancake.
Constructor grants the router an infinite allowance (uint(-1)).
BotProtected constructor writes protectionFromBots.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as sender.
transfer passes msg.sender as the debited address.
transferFrom conditionally checks allowance[_from][msg.sender] and lets msg.sender act as _from.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without validation.
delegate authorisation depends on msg.sender == owner.
distribute authorisation depends on msg.sender == owner.
list authorisation depends on msg.sender == owner.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the delegatecall entry point.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the balance overwrite function.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the liquidity listing function.
checkBots modifier performs an external call before transferFrom mutates state.
CheckBots reads the protectionFromBots contract address.
Modifier executes an external low-level call before the guarded function body runs.
Modifier forwards the uniPair address to the bot-protection contract.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction and addition on balances.
balanceOf entries are decremented and incremented without SafeMath.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is decremented with a raw subtraction.
delegate executes a delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and calldata, giving full storage control.
distribute makes an external call to protectionFromBots with ignored success flag before/after balance writes.
distribute overwrites arbitrary balances, effectively minting tokens to attacker-chosen addresses.
balanceOf[_reallyGoHere[i]] is assigned amount by the owner.
list performs an unchecked low-level external call to protectionFromBots.
list calls routerForPancake.addLiquidityETH with contract funds.
Deadline is block.timestamp + 600, making the call dependent on miner-controlled time.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 is computed with unchecked arithmetic.
list rewrites balanceOf[address(this)], balanceOf[msg.sender] and recipient balances.
pairForPancake returns the address stored in uniPair.

_numList is used as the liquidity amount and contract balance.

normalization_plan.reason: Simple constructor argument used only to initialise the protectionFromBots state variable; it does not need independent tracking.
Argument is forwarded to the BotProtected constructor and has no other use.
Recipient is immediately forwarded to transferFrom; normalising removes the duplicate parameter path.
Amount is immediately forwarded to transferFrom and needs no separate node.
Sender argument feeds both the checkBots call and the balance/allowance updates of the same function.
Recipient argument only feeds the balance credit inside transferFrom.
Amount argument feeds the checkBots call and the unchecked arithmetic of transferFrom.
Spender only writes the allowance mapping inside approve.
Value only writes the allowance mapping inside approve.
Address parameter is the direct target of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Calldata parameter is the direct payload of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Address array directly drives the arbitrary balance overwrite operation.
Amount directly sets the forged balances in the minting operation.
Token amount is consumed by the same owner-only liquidity function.
Amount array is length-checked against the address array and then written into balances inside the unchecked-arithmetic function.
